name: Enterpret
description: Turn customer feedback into answers you can act on, directly in Claude. Query your Enterpret knowledge graph across support tickets, Gong calls, app reviews, NPS surveys, Slack, and more. Every insight is traced back to real customer conversations with direct links. Just ask a question in plain language. No query language or setup needed.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Enterpret to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Enterpret to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://wisdom-api.enterpret.com/server/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Enterpret MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Enterpret provides these MCP tools: get_organization_details, get_graph_schema, run_graph_query, search_graph_values, get_query_examples, search_graph_fields, and find_user_quote.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Enterpret?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Enterpret in data on the Manufact MCP catalog include Aura, Clarivate IPOne CompuMark Trademarks, Motion Creative Analytics, Nimble, and Origin.
Enterpret requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Enterpret is developed by Enterpret Inc. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
